description: Source code for data retention policy management in Mattermost server application, including functions for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting retention policies, as well as managing associated teams and channels.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Represents the application context with methods to manage data retention policies.

methods.name: GetGlobalRetentionPolicy
methods.description: Retrieves the global data retention policy if licensed.

methods.name: GetRetentionPolicies
methods.description: Fetches a list of retention policies with pagination.

methods.name: GetRetentionPoliciesCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of retention policies.

methods.name: GetRetentionPolicy
methods.description: Retrieves a specific retention policy by ID.

methods.name: DeleteRetentionPolicy
methods.description: Deletes a retention policy by ID.

methods.name: GetTeamsForRetentionPolicy
methods.description: Gets teams associated with a retention policy.

methods.name: AddTeamsToRetentionPolicy
methods.description: Associates teams with a retention policy.

methods.name: RemoveTeamsFromRetentionPolicy
methods.description: Removes team associations from a retention policy.

methods.name: GetChannelsForRetentionPolicy
methods.description: Gets channels associated with a retention policy.

methods.name: AddChannelsToRetentionPolicy
methods.description: Associates channels with a retention policy.

methods.name: RemoveChannelsFromRetentionPolicy
methods.description: Removes channel associations from a retention policy.

methods.name: GetTeamPoliciesForUser
methods.description: Retrieves retention policies assigned to a user for teams.

methods.name: GetChannelPoliciesForUser
methods.description: Retrieves retention policies assigned to a user for channels.
